claims: American Idol 2026 voting for the Top 20 begins on March 16, 2026.
American Idol 2026 voting features social media voting.
Fans can vote up to 10 times per contestant per method on AmericanIdol.com/Vote, text, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok.
Up to 50 votes total per user for American Idol 2026 voting.
Online voting for American Idol 2026 is at AmericanIdol.com/Vote.
Social media voting for American Idol 2026 is at @AmericanIdol on Facebook, Instagram, or TikTok.
Social media voting for American Idol 2026 requires finding the pinned "Official Vote Post" and commenting the first name of the artist.
Text voting for American Idol 2026 is by sending text messages to 21523.
Specific voting lines for American Idol 2026 contestants are announced during the show.
Users can cast up to 10 votes per artist on each of the three platforms (website, text, social media) for American Idol 2026.
American Idol 2026 voters must be 16 or older.
American Idol 2026 voters must be located in the U.S., Puerto Rico, or the Virgin Islands.
American Idol 2026 Top 20 Voting (First Vote) opens on Monday, March 16, 2026, at 8 p.m. ET during the show.
American Idol 2026 Top 20 Voting (First Vote) closes on Tuesday, March 17, at 6 a.m. ET.
American Idol 2026 Top 20 Voting (Second Vote) opens on Monday, March 23, 2026.
The American Idol app has been retired for the 2026 season.
The American Idol app has been replaced by social media voting for the 2026 season.
